data.one_liner: Open backdrop modal routes and non-sticky bottom sheets with minimal code.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom ModalRoute for Flutter to easily create backdrop modal routes and non-sticky bottom sheets with dynamic content and customizable transitions.
use_when: You need a modal route that displays a backdrop and dynamic content.
You want a non-sticky bottom sheet experience.
avoid_when: You need standard Material bottom sheets without custom backdrop requirements.
strengths: Minimal code and effort to implement.
Supports custom block modal transitions and SafeArea configurations.
weaknesses: Scrolling content hiding behavior must be implemented manually by the developer.
